latHint: Think the lone item that always goes missing in the dryer.
pivHint: A garden HOSE is a long tube for watering plants. Long ago, HOSE also meant a snug covering for the legs and feet, like the ______ you pull on before shoes.
winText: Well covered. HOSE was the pivot - a watering tube to an old word for SOCKS.
lossText: SOCKS - soft coverings worn on the feet. HOSE was the pivot: a garden HOSE waters plants, but HOSE is also an old word for leg and foot coverings, the kind we now call SOCKS.
